title: Executive
jobDescription:
Any Graduate

Proven experience (1-3 years) in providing IT support, preferably in a warehouse or logistics setting.

Strong knowledge of computer hardware, operating systems, and software applications, Basic network systems.

Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

Customer-focused with outstanding communication and interpersonal abilities.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Detail-oriented and well-organized.

Willingness to work in shifts or extended hours, if required.

1. Help Desk Support:

  • Act as the first point of contact for warehouse staff seeking technical assistance, both in person and remotely.
  • Provide prompt and efficient resolution of hardware, software, and network-related issues.


2. Troubleshooting and Problem Resolution:

  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues reported by warehouse personnel related to computers, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment.
  • Escalate complex problems to the IT team or vendors when necessary and follow up to ensure timely resolution.


3. Inventory Management:

  • Maintain an accurate inventory of IT hardware, software licenses, and related equipment used in the warehouse.
  • Assist in the procurement and deployment of new IT assets as needed.


4. Data Security and Backup:

  • Ensure data security measures are followed, including regular backups of critical systems and data.
  • Assist in implementing security protocols to protect sensitive information.


5. User Training and Documentation:

  • Conduct training sessions for warehouse personnel on IT procedures, best practices, and software usage.
  • Maintain documentation for IT processes, troubleshooting guides, and user manuals.

title: Assistant Manager
jobDescription:
Designation: Assistant Manager/Deputy Manager (Direct Company Appointments)

We are seeking a high-calibre, strategic Brand Onboarding & Manufacturer Relations

Manager to spearhead the expansion of our large-scale pharmaceutical distribution network.

In this role, you will be the primary face of our warehouse and logistics network, actively

engaging with pharmaceutical manufacturers, life sciences brands, and biotech companies

to onboard their products & getting direct appointments into our ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturer & Brand Acquisition: Proactively identify, target, and engage with

pharmaceutical manufacturers and healthcare brands to pitch our distribution and

warehousing solutions.

Value Proposition Delivery: Educate prospective partners on our network's unique

capabilities, including temperature-controlled storage (cold chain), GDP (Good Distribution

Practice) compliance, and tech-driven inventory tracking.

End-to-End Onboarding: Lead the integration process for newly signed brands,

coordinating between the manufacturer’s supply chain teams and our internal warehouse

operations to ensure flawless inventory transition.

Contract & Commercial Negotiation: Structure, negotiate, and close commercial

agreements, ensuring alignment on pricing, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and liability

terms.

Relationship Management: Serve as the strategic point of contact for onboarded brands,

ensuring high satisfaction, retention, and the expansion of their product portfolios within our

network.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Regional, Legal, and Warehouse

Operations teams to ensure all onboarding processes strictly align with pharmaceutical

regulatory standards.

Required Qualifications & Skills

3-5+ years of experience in B2B business development, account management, or supply

chain relations, specifically within the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare logistics

sectors.

Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of pharma supply chain dynamics, including cold

chain requirements, inventory models, and regulatory frameworks (e.g., FDA, GDP, or local

equivalents).

Communication Mastery: Exceptional negotiation, pitching, and relationship-building skills.

You must be comfortable speaking the language of pharma executives, procurement heads,

and quality compliance officers.

Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex, multi-phase onboarding projects

involving tight deadlines and strict compliance checks.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Supply Chain Management,

Pharmacy, or a related field (MBA or equivalent is a plus).
